blurb: Guests can rent pontoon boats with professional navigation orientation to explore Hilton Head waterways including Broad Creek, May River, and Cooper River. Private tubing trips are available for groups up to 12 passengers. The Golden Hour Sunset Sail offers a 2-hour catamaran cruise with complimentary drinks and coastal bites. The Daufuskie Island Day Trip includes ferry, golf cart rental, and meal vouchers. The Kids 2-Day Adventure Camp includes watersports and exploration activities for ages 8
